backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister actor with no defined methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to source files and components with confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Plain-text summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base layer defining OKLCH theme tokens and global styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML template mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component implementing the FBC input UI, validation, report generation, and user actions with toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity and React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, login state, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS file defining a clinical teal theme and global styles for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/fbcReport.ts: Implements FBC report generation, including numeric parsing, flagging ranges, interpreting RBC/WBC/platelet results, and outputting a formatted text report.
frontend/src/lib/fbcValidation.ts: Validates FBC input fields by ensuring all required numeric values are present and parsable.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides a utility function to merge Tailwind and class names using clsx and twMerge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers and renders the root component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, color tokens, plugins, and container settings for the frontend UI.
project_state.json: Describes the project state, requirements, architecture, planned features, and image assets for the HemaAssist application.
